t: Skip the Dealerships: Canadian startup Curbie raises $7 million - Uniting the Prairies
s: After a terrible experience visiting dealerships, researching and negotiating to help his mother purchase a used vehicle in 2017, Curbie CEO Alex Cruder knew there had to be a better way. Hearing of a U.S. company called Carvana finding success with a click-to-buy model, he knew there would be Canadians looking for a similar solution.
